lines.en: Every description of the world leaves something out.
lines.zh: 对世界的每一种描述，都会漏掉一些东西。

lines.en: Two different things look the same through your lens, and the difference slips away. That is information escape.
lines.zh: 两个不同的东西，透过你的镜头看起来一模一样，差别就此溜走。这，就是信息逃逸。

lines.en: Most theories hide their leaks. This project measures them.
lines.zh: 大多数理论把漏洞藏起来。这个项目，去测量它们。

lines.en: Where did information escape? How was it handled? What new information emerged? And where does it keep escaping?
lines.zh: 信息从哪里逃逸？逃逸被如何处理？出现了什么新信息？它又在哪里继续逃逸？

lines.en: Start with an arena: four states, two switches. Twelve ordered pairs of different states.
lines.zh: 从一个竞技场开始：四个状态，两个开关。不同状态的有序对，一共十二个。

lines.en: Read both switches, and every pair is told apart. Nothing escapes.
lines.zh: 同时读两个开关，每一对都被区分开。没有任何东西逃逸。

lines.en: Forget one switch, and four of the twelve pairs collapse into sameness. The escape rate jumps from zero to one third. Proved in Lean, as an exact fraction.
lines.zh: 忘掉一个开关，十二对里有四对坍缩成相同。逃逸率从零跳到三分之一。在 Lean 中证明，是一个精确的分数。

lines.en: So what is a theorem worth? Remove it from the catalog, and count the pairs that only it could separate. Those are its unique captures.
lines.zh: 那么，一条定理值多少？把它从目录里拿走，数一数只有它才能区分的状态对。那就是它的独占捕获。

lines.en: A theorem strictly lowers escape exactly when it has a unique capture, exactly when no other theorem can reconstruct what it sees.
lines.zh: 一条定理严格降低逃逸，当且仅当它有独占捕获，当且仅当其余定理都无法重建它所看见的东西。

lines.en: But zero unique capture is not worthlessness. Three readouts can each be redundant, while any one of them still does real work.
lines.zh: 但独占捕获为零，不等于没有价值。三个读数可以各自冗余，而其中任何一个仍在做真实的工作。

lines.en: Climb a ladder of knowing, in one Lean model. Forty-eight states, two thousand two hundred fifty-six pairs.
lines.zh: 爬一架认知的梯子，在一个 Lean 模型里。四十八个状态，两千二百五十六个状态对。

lines.en: Watching the world leaves one hundred thirty-six pairs indistinguishable. Intervening on it leaves forty-four. Asking what would have happened otherwise leaves zero.
lines.zh: 观察世界，仍有一百三十六对无法区分。干预世界，剩下四十四对。追问“否则会怎样”，剩下零。

lines.en: Seeing, doing, imagining. Each rung catches what the one below let escape.
lines.zh: 看、做、设想。每一级阶梯，都接住了下一级放走的东西。

lines.en: Some escape can be cut away by a better definition, like an auxiliary line in geometry.
lines.zh: 有些逃逸可以被更好的定义切掉，就像几何里的一条辅助线。

lines.en: Some cannot. The residual splits exactly into removable confusion, and a blind core that no definition in your language can reach.
lines.zh: 有些不能。残差恰好分解为两部分：可移除的混淆，和一个盲核——你的语言里没有任何定义能触及它。

lines.en: If the blind core is not empty, no family of definitions, of any size, recovers the target. Even the strongest search inside the language will not succeed. You need a new language.
lines.zh: 只要盲核非空，无论多大的定义族，都无法恢复目标。语言内部再强的搜索也不会成功。你需要一门新的语言。

lines.en: Spend more, and the leak shrinks, but only toward a floor. Returns diminish.
lines.zh: 投入更多，漏洞会缩小，但只会趋向一个底线。收益递减。

lines.en: And there are stranger worlds. In one proved counter-model, no single pair is blind, yet every finite budget leaves the full leak open. Forever.
lines.zh: 还有更奇异的世界。在一个已证明的反模型里，没有任何一对是盲的，可是每一份有限的预算，都让漏洞完整地敞开。永远。

lines.en: When more effort brings no gain, stop grinding. Change the frame.
lines.zh: 当更多努力不再带来收益，别再死磨。换一个框架。

lines.en: Now the oldest escape of all. Write any catalog as a grid. Walk down its diagonal, and twist every entry.
lines.zh: 现在，最古老的逃逸。把任何一个目录写成网格。沿着对角线走下去，把每一格都扭转一下。

lines.en: The result differs from every row. It cannot be in the catalog. Cantor saw it; here it is a kernel-checked theorem.
lines.zh: 结果与每一行都不同。它不可能在目录之中。康托尔看见了它；在这里，它是一条经内核核验的定理。

lines.en: No fixed catalog is complete. Diagonalization generates escape; observation decides whether that escape stays visible.
lines.zh: 没有哪个固定的目录是完备的。对角化制造逃逸；观察决定这逃逸是否仍然可见。

lines.en: So how does anything new get discovered? The object does not change. The fiber structure describing it does.
lines.zh: 那么，新东西是如何被发现的？对象没有改变。描述对象的纤维结构改变了。

lines.en: A new definition cuts the fibers. The pairs that survive are exactly those the old concept merged, and the new cut cannot tell apart.
lines.zh: 一个新定义切开纤维。幸存下来的状态对，恰好是旧概念合并、而新切口也分不开的那些。

lines.en: Creation is structural escape, plus low-cost recovery.
lines.zh: 创造，就是结构性逃逸，加上低成本回收。

lines.en: A warning for every learning machine. Copy a table of past answers, and your error on the past is exactly zero.
lines.zh: 给每一台学习机器的警告：复制一张过去答案的表，你在过去上的误差恰好为零。

lines.en: It is proved that this copier fails the test of not peeking. Perfect hindsight is not foresight.
lines.zh: 已经证明：这个复制器无法通过“不偷看未来”的检验。完美的后见之明，不是预见。

lines.en: So the project built a judge. Every new theorem registers four slots: where information escaped, how it was read, what it realizes, and where it continues to escape.
lines.zh: 于是项目建造了一位判官。每一条新定理都要登记四个槽位：信息从哪里逃逸、如何被读出、实现了什么、又在哪里继续逃逸。

lines.en: Ninety-five registrations so far. In fifty of them, the last slot simply says: open. An honest unknown, not a claim of impossibility.
lines.zh: 目前已有九十五条登记。其中五十条，最后一个槽位只写着：open。一个诚实的未知，而不是不可能的断言。

lines.en: Others carry a witness: a concrete pair that still cannot be told apart, checked by the kernel. The judge is still being built, and it only warns. It never blocks.
lines.zh: 另一些带着见证：一对仍然无法区分的具体状态，由内核核验。判官仍在建设中，它只警告，从不阻断。

lines.en: On a finite arena, refinement must stop: at most n minus one strict steps. But any fixed catalog still leaks along its diagonal.
lines.zh: 在有限的竞技场上，细化必然停止：至多 n 减一步严格细化。但任何固定的目录，仍会沿着对角线泄漏。

lines.en: Where does information continue to escape? That is not a failure. That is the direction of the next discovery.
lines.zh: 信息还在哪里继续逃逸？这不是失败。这正是下一次发现的方向。
